content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: This is a direct recruitment for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts in the child development projects running in the urban and rural areas of Pilibhit district, made under Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17 September 2025.

rows.details: Office of the District Programme Officer, Janpad Pilibhit, Uttar Pradesh
Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper Direct Recruitment, Pilibhit
Amariya, Barkhera, Bilsanda, Bisalpur, Lalaurikhera, Marauri, Shahar (City), Puranpur
Minimum Intermediate or equivalent, maximum postgraduate
Women only; permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post
Merit on qualifications from Intermediate to postgraduate, with preference and reservation as per Government Order

content_sections.heading: About Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District Programme Officer, Janpad Pilibhit, which oversees the child development (Bal Vikas) projects of the district. The posts are at Anganwadi centres run under these projects in urban and rural areas, and the notice was signed by District Programme Officer Yugal Kishore Sanguri. A copy of the notice was sent to the Director, Bal Vikas Sewa evam Pushtahar, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow, and it was to be published in Dainik Jagran and Dainik Hindustan.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 130 Anganwadi Worker and 153 Anganwadi Helper posts, a total of 283 posts across eight child development projects. The notice says the number of vacancies may be decreased or increased.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Category-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Anganwadi centre-wise and gram sabha-wise / ward-wise details of these posts, with the reservation and full eligibility, are pasted on the notice boards of Vikas Bhawan / the District Programme Office, the Tehsil, the concerned Child Development Project office and the development block offices, and are uploaded on http://upanganwadibharti.in . Reservation for SC, ST and OBC follows Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17 September 2025.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Other conditions printed in the notice: Only women candidates are eligible for the advertised posts. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post. If no application is received from the gram sabha, residents of the concerned Nyay Panchayat are considered. For proof of residence, the residence certificate must carry the name of the ward / gram panchayat; this is mandatory. Two women of the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker / Helper at one Anganwadi centre. For the centre-wise eligibility of each post, check the detailed notice on http://upanganwadibharti.in and the notice boards listed above.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum educational qualification Intermediate or its equivalent, and maximum postgraduate

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants for both posts must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 35 years old on the cut-off date of 01.07.2026. Only the date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet / certificate is accepted for age. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes both posts as honorarium-based but does not mention the honorarium amount or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Merit is determined on the basis of the candidate's qualifications from Intermediate up to postgraduate. As per the Government Order, preference in selection is given to women from families living below the poverty line, widows, abandoned (parityakta) women and divorced women. Selection follows the SC / ST / OBC reservation laid down in Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17 September 2025. For the poverty-line preference, the income limit fixed by Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14.09.2015 (as amended) of Social Welfare Section-2, Uttar Pradesh is applied. At present it is Rs 46080.00 a year in rural areas and Rs 56460.00 a year in urban areas.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in , where the detailed form and information for these posts are available. Fill in the online application correctly and carefully. Upload clean and legible self-attested copies of the records mentioned in your online form. Submit the application by 12:00 midnight on 3 December 2026. Applications are accepted only online within the prescribed period. No application, record or form sent offline or by post will be accepted under any circumstances. High School marksheet / certificate (for date of birth). Residence certificate issued online with digital signature by the Tehsil, verifiable online, showing the name of the ward / gram panchayat. Caste certificate issued online with digital signature by the Tehsil, verifiable online. Income certificate issued at the competent level (Tehsil), verifiable online, as per Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj0-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended) of Revenue Section-9, Uttar Pradesh. Widows: death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat officer / concerned urban local body and a certified copy of the family register. Divorced / abandoned women: the legal order issued by the Hon'ble court.

content_sections.heading: Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If any error is found in the application, or any fact, figure, or marks obtained / maximum marks in the educational records are found wrong or forged, the candidature will be cancelled. The number of vacancies may be decreased or increased. For more information, contact the Child Development Project Officer's office of your development block or Room No. 37, District Programme Officer Office, Vikas Bhawan, Pilibhit during office hours on working days. All Child Development Project Officers of Pilibhit have been directed to paste the full details of the posts on the notice boards of project offices, Tehsils, development block offices and the concerned gram panchayats / wards.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 283 posts: 130 Anganwadi Worker (Karyakatri) and 153 Anganwadi Helper (Sahayika) posts across eight child development projects of Pilibhit district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted up to 12:00 midnight on 3 December 2026 at http://upanganwadibharti.in.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Pilibhit Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate or its equivalent and the maximum is postgraduate, and merit is worked out from qualifications from Intermediate to postgraduate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must be 18 to 35 years old as on 01.07.2026, with age counted from the date of birth in the High School marksheet / certificate.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women can apply, and they must be permanent residents of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post; if no application comes from the gram sabha, residents of the concerned Nyay Panchayat are considered.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for Pilibhit Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit from Intermediate to postgraduate qualifications, with preference to BPL families, widows, abandoned and divorced women, and reservation as per the Government Order dated 17 September 2025.

faq.question: Q7. What is the BPL income limit for preference in Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The poverty-line income limit is Rs 46080.00 a year in rural areas and Rs 56460.00 a year in urban areas, as per the Government Order dated 14.09.2015.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply offline or by post for Pilibhit Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only online at http://upanganwadibharti.in, and no application, record or form sent offline or by post is accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Can two women from the same family be appointed at one Anganwadi centre?
faq.answer: No. Two women of the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker / Helper at one Anganwadi centre.

faq.question: Q10. Which project in Pilibhit has the most Anganwadi vacancies?
faq.answer: Puranpur has the most posts, with 24 Anganwadi Worker and 35 Anganwadi Helper vacancies.
